shot.name: storm-question
shot.prompt: Photoreal cinematic miniature world, tactile ivory origami paper boat with one crisp triangular sail and sharply folded hull, no writing on the paper. Warm amber practical light against deep petrol-blue shadows, natural film contrast, 35mm commercial cinematography. The same single small ivory paper boat is the only hero object. A small ivory origami sailboat rides up a towering dark ocean swell. The sea is deep petrol blue under heavy storm clouds; a narrow amber light remains far away. Low close camera beside the hull makes the fragile paper boat feel small against the moving wall of water. The boat stays sharply folded, visible and intact, no sinking, no tearing. Slow dramatic forward camera movement. One uninterrupted five-second shot.
